versions.subject: new rules: lnx susp shell exec
versions.detection:
selection_base64:
    CommandLine|contains: 'base64 -w0 '
selection_exec:
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - '| bash '
        - '| sh '
        - '|bash '
        - '|sh '
    - CommandLine|endswith:
        - '| bash'
        - '| sh'
        - '|bash'
        - ' |sh'
condition: selection_base64 and selection_exec
versions.spl: CommandLine="*base64 -w0 *" CommandLine IN ("*| bash *", "*| sh *", "*|bash *", "*|sh *") OR CommandLine IN ("*| bash", "*| sh", "*|bash", "* |sh")
